text:
incident-bot: PAGER -> [P1] eu-west1-serving: automated pool evacuation triggered due to node instability. Routing to #incidents and paging oncall. brief: elevated 5xxs and tokenization errors on embeddings path. paging alex.

alex: On the bridge now. What do we know about surface area?

sara: Linking graphs — 95th latency spike around 03:17Z, error ratio ~12% for /v1/embeddings in eu-west1. Other regions normal.

alex: Confirmed. Cause looks like a memory corruption on 1 of the serving nodes leading to KV cache thrash. I'm coordinating a targeted drain of the affected node.

ops-lead: Good. Plan: drain node -> restart runtime -> monitor 10m. If errors persist, roll affected pool. @customer-success do we need an immediate status page entry?

customer-success: Yes please. Short, clear messaging only. Draft below (please review):
```
Status: Partial degradation — eu-west1 embeddings
Impact: Customers using embeddings in eu-west1 may experience increased latency or transient errors.
When: starting ~03:20Z, mitigations in progress.
What we're doing: our engineers are performing a controlled drain and restart of a small group of nodes in eu-west1. We expect service to be restored within 30 minutes. We'll post updates here and on the status page.
```

alex: That looks good. Add a line: "If you're on Dedicated capacity in eu-west1 and see persistent errors, open a support ticket and we'll prioritize."

customer-success: Added. Final draft below. I'll post to status.redwood.com/current-incidents after we confirm drain success.

mike: Logging note — saving current kernel logs and core dumps to /var/persistent/evac/1795004000 for postmortem. Also creating temporary alert suppression for noisy downstream alerts so we don't drown the pager.

ops-lead: Good call. alex, once the node restarts, run smoke: `curl -s -X POST https://eu-west1.api.redwood/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}'` and confirm 200 + normal latency.

alex: Will do. Starting drain now (03:24Z). ETA restart by 03:28Z.

sara: Monitoring dashboards — error rate falling marginally after drain initiated. KV miss rate decreasing.

alex: Node restarted and smoke test passed (200, latency 120ms). Observability: 5xx down to baseline, no new crash reports.

ops-lead: Nice. Hold on monitoring for 20m, then close. customer-success, please post status page update marking "mitigation in progress" -> "service degraded, mitigations applied" and note customer support runway.

customer-success: Posted update to status page and sent a short email to impacted customers (template below).
```
Subject: Short notice: transient degradation of embeddings in eu-west1 — mitigations applied
Hi — we applied mitigations for a short degradation affecting embeddings in eu-west1. If you still see issues, reply and we'll prioritize. Services are returning to normal; we will follow up if there's any further impact. — Redwood Inference Ops
```

mike: Archive note: incident-bot alert id 1795004000 -> created internal incident doc, saved artifacts to s3://redwood-incidents/1795004000.

ops-lead: Handing off to monitoring watch: alex -> sara for the 20m observe window. If stable, we'll mark this resolved and create a short postmortem focusing on node-level memory corruption and kernel version mismatch.

alex: Handoff acknowledged. Oncall -> sara. I'm around if anything spikes.

sara: Acknowledged, monitoring for 20m. Will update thread if anything changes, otherwise will close and add timeline + owner for postmortem tasks. :white_check_mark:
